source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1955, p. 8; Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1955, p. 8
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Votes as printed: 'Monkstown-R. H. Kirkpatrick, 440; R. Johnston, 298-majority 144' read on the page image of the News-Letter, 4 June 1955, p. 8; 440-298=142, the paper prints 144 (both figures are clear, so the votes are kept).

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Six of the nine seats were contested; the results were announced on 3 June (Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1955, p. 8).
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1955, p. 8 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the result is now cited to the page that prints it (the 9 May 1955 page cited alone before does not name R. Johnston); names and votes unchanged.
